crossRefs.note: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
They who render evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
King David longed to go out to Absalom; for he was comforted concerning Amnon, since he was dead.
Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.
Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

translations.web: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
translations.bsb: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
translations.kjv: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
translations.asv: For my love they are my adversaries: But I give myself unto prayer.
